board_events.text: Irreversible cooling across a gap creates net entropy

segments.text: One irreversible process that creates net entropy, and one reversible cycle that creates none.

Advanced level. A two-kilogram metal block at four hundred kelvin is dropped into a very large lake at three hundred kelvin and cools to three hundred kelvin. Its specific heat is four hundred joules per kilogram per kelvin.
The block's entropy falls as it orders, but the lake's rises more.

Computing along a reversible path, the block's entropy change is m c times the log of final over initial temperature: eight hundred times the log of three hundred over four hundred, about minus two hundred thirty joules per kelvin.

The lake is a reservoir at constant three hundred kelvin; it gains the heat the block lost, m c times the temperature drop, eighty thousand joules. So its entropy change is plus that over three hundred, about plus two hundred sixty-seven joules per kelvin.
So the universe change is minus two hundred thirty plus two hundred sixty-seven, about plus thirty-seven joules per kelvin, positive.
The block's entropy falls, but the lake's rises more; the irreversible cooling across a finite temperature gap creates net entropy, exactly as the second law demands.

And the reversible check: a Carnot cycle with six hundred joules absorbed at five hundred kelvin gains plus one point two, and rejecting three hundred sixty at three hundred kelvin loses minus one point two, netting zero, which is exactly the relation Q two over Q one equals T two over T one.
एक irreversible process जो net entropy बनाती है, और एक reversible cycle जो कोई नहीं बनाती।

Advanced level. four hundred kelvin का एक two-kilogram metal block एक बहुत बड़ी तीन सौ kelvin की झील में गिराया जाता है और three hundred kelvin तक ठंडा होता है। इसकी specific heat है four hundred joules per kilogram per kelvin.
block की entropy गिरती है जैसे वो order होता है, पर झील की ज़्यादा बढ़ती है।

reversible path पr compute करते हुए, block का entropy change है m c into log of final over initial temperature: eight hundred into log of three hundred over four hundred, लगभग minus two hundred thirty joules per kelvin.

झील तीन सौ kelvin पर एक reservoir है; यह वो heat पाती है जो block ने खोई, m c into temperature drop, eighty thousand joules. तो इसका entropy change है plus वो over three hundred, लगभग plus two hundred sixty-seven joules per kelvin.
तो universe change है minus two hundred thirty plus two hundred sixty-seven, लगभग plus thirty-seven joules per kelvin, positive.
block की entropy गिरती है, पर झील की ज़्यादा बढ़ती है; finite temperature gap के पार irreversible cooling net entropy बनाती है, ठीक जैसा second law माँगता है।

और reversible check: five hundred kelvin पr six hundred joules absorb करता एक Carnot cycle plus one point two पाता है, और three hundred kelvin पr three hundred sixty reject करके minus one point two खोता है, net zero, ठीक वो relation Q two over Q one बराबर T two over T one.

sections.subtopic: Entropy and the Quantified Second Law (JEE Advanced Extension)
sections.title: Common pitfalls and pro-tips

board_events.text: Four traps, then the split-and-add habit
1. Irreversible $\Delta S_{sys}$: route through a reversible path
2. The law constrains the universe, not the system alone
3. Use the kelvin temperature of the exchange
4. Entropy is in joules per kelvin, not joules
Split into system and surroundings, then add
Carnot check: the cyclic integral of $dQ/T$ is zero

segments.text: This subtopic converts the qualitative arrow of time into a calculable state function. Here are the traps.
Trap one. Using the actual heat for the entropy change of an irreversible process. The system's change must be computed along a reversible path with the same endpoints, not from the actual heat.
Trap two. Forgetting the surroundings. The second law constrains the entropy change of the universe, not the system alone; a system's entropy may legitimately fall.
Trap three. Using the wrong temperature in the heat over temperature ratio. Use the kelvin temperature at which the heat is exchanged; for a reservoir, its own constant temperature.
Trap four. Treating entropy as energy. Entropy has units of joules per kelvin, not joules; it measures disorder, not stored energy.

Speed habit. For irreversible problems, always split into system and surroundings, compute each entropy change separately, then add. The universe total must come out at least zero; a negative answer is a guaranteed sign error.
And remember the elegant consistency check: a reversible Carnot cycle gives a cyclic integral of dQ over T equal to zero, which is the very relation Q two over Q one equals T two over T one.
यह subtopic time के qualitative arrow को एक calculable state function में बदलता है। यह रहे traps.
Trap एक। किसी irreversible process के entropy change के लिए actual heat use करना। system का change उन्हीं endpoints वाले reversible path पर निकालना चाहिए, actual heat से नहीं।
Trap दो। surroundings भूलना। second law universe के entropy change को बाँधता है, अकेले system को नहीं; किसी system की entropy सही में गिर सकती है।
Trap तीन। heat over temperature ratio में ग़लत temperature use करना। वो kelvin temperature use करो जिस पर heat exchange होती है; reservoir के लिए, उसका अपना constant temperature.
Trap चार। entropy को energy मानना। entropy की units joules per kelvin हैं, joules नहीं; यह disorder मापती है, stored energy नहीं।

Speed habit. irreversible problems के लिए, हमेशा system और surroundings में बाँटो, हर entropy change अलग निकालो, फिर जोड़ो। universe total कम से कम zero निकलना चाहिए; negative answer पक्का sign error है।
और वो सुंदर consistency check याद रखो: एक reversible Carnot cycle dQ over T का cyclic integral zero देता है, ठीक वो relation Q two over Q one बराबर T two over T one.

sections.title: The whole chapter on one page

board_events.text: One consolidated formula sheet for the chapter

board_events.latex: PV=nRT;\quad \Delta Q=\Delta U+\Delta W;\quad \Delta W=\int P\,dV;\quad \Delta U=nC_V\,\Delta T

board_events.text: First law conserves energy; second law fixes direction

segments.text: <excited>Every equation that matters in thermodynamics, gathered in the order you actually use them.
The foundation: the ideal-gas law, and the first law with work as the area under the curve and the internal-energy change riding C-V in every process.
The four processes: isochoric does no work; isobaric work is n R times the temperature change; isothermal work is the n R T log; adiabatic obeys P V to the gamma and pays work from internal energy.
The capacities: Mayer's relation, the equipartition value, gamma from degrees of freedom, and the two reflex identities from gamma.
Engines, refrigerators, and heat pumps, all from one balance: work is Q one minus Q two; efficiency and the two coefficients follow, and the pump coefficient is the fridge coefficient plus one.
The Carnot ceiling, in kelvin: efficiency one minus T two over T one, the heat ratio equal to the temperature ratio, and the ideal coefficients sharing the denominator T one minus T two.
Entropy: the reversible-heat definition, the universe never decreasing, and the two everyday changes for isothermal expansion and a phase change.

The golden thread through all of it: the first law is bookkeeping, it conserves energy, while the second law is direction, it never lets the entropy of the universe fall. Every formula above hangs on one of those two ideas.
<excited>thermodynamics की हर ज़रूरी equation, उसी क्रम में इकट्ठा जिसमें आप सच में use करते हो।
बुनियाद: ideal-gas law, और first law जिसमें work curve के नीचे का area है और internal-energy change हर process में C-V पर चलता है।
चार processes: isochoric कोई work नहीं करती; isobaric work n R into temperature change; isothermal work n R T log; adiabatic P V to the gamma मानती है और work internal energy से चुकाती है।
capacities: Mayer's relation, equipartition value, degrees of freedom से gamma, और gamma से दो reflex identities.
engines, refrigerators, और heat pumps, सब एक balance से: work है Q one minus Q two; efficiency और दो coefficients निकलते हैं, और pump coefficient है fridge coefficient plus one.
Carnot ceiling, kelvin में: efficiency one minus T two over T one, heat ratio बराबर temperature ratio, और ideal coefficients denominator T one minus T two share करते हैं।
entropy: reversible-heat definition, universe कभी नहीं घटता, और दो रोज़मर्रा changes isothermal expansion और phase change के लिए।

इस सबका सुनहरा धागा: first law bookkeeping है, यह energy conserve करता है, जबकि second law direction है, यह universe की entropy को कभी गिरने नहीं देता। ऊपर की हर formula इन्हीं दो ideas में से एक पर टिकी है।

sections.title: Rapid recap and memory aids

board_events.text: One crisp line per idea, exam-ready
$U,P,V,T$ are state; $Q,W$ are path; a cycle has $\Delta U=0$
Vertical, horizontal, curve, steeper curve; area is work
Count $f$: $C_V=\tfrac{f}{2}R$, add $R$ for $C_P$; $\Delta U$ uses $C_V$
$W=Q_1-Q_2$; COP denominator is $W$; COP can exceed one
Kelvin-Planck, Clausius, equivalent; reversible = slow and lossless
Carnot ceiling $1-T_2/T_1$ in kelvin; lower the sink to gain most
Entropy $=dQ_{rev}/T$; the universe total never falls
Name the process, pick the law, use kelvin, fix the signs

segments.text: The night-before recap: one crisp line per idea, the way you want it in your head walking into the exam.

State versus path. Pressure, volume, temperature, and internal energy are state; heat and work are path. The internal-energy change always rides C-V. Over a full cycle the internal-energy change is zero, so net heat equals net work.

Reading a P-V graph. Vertical is isochoric, horizontal is isobaric, a gentle curve is isothermal, and the steeper curve, steeper by the factor gamma, is adiabatic. Work is the area under the curve; the enclosed area of a clockwise loop is an engine's output.

Capacities in one breath. Count the degrees of freedom, three for monoatomic, five for diatomic, six for polyatomic; C-V is f over two R; add R for C-P; gamma is five thirds, seven fifths, or four thirds. The internal-energy change never uses C-P.
Engines and fridges. Work is Q one minus Q two; efficiency is the take-home fraction of Q one; the coefficient denominator is always the work, and a coefficient can exceed one.

The second law in words. Kelvin-Planck bans an engine of efficiency one; Clausius bans free heat from cold to hot; the two are equivalent. Reversible means slow and lossless together, never just slow.

Carnot is the crown. It is the ceiling, efficiency one minus T two over T one, always in kelvin, independent of the working substance; and lowering the cold sink raises efficiency more than raising the hot source.

Entropy quantifies the arrow. It is the reversible heat over temperature; the entropy of the universe never decreases; for irreversible problems split system and surroundings, compute each, and add; the total is zero only for a reversible process.
One exam reflex above all. First name the process, then choose the law; convert every temperature to kelvin; and write out the full sign convention before you substitute a single number.
रात-पहले का recap: हर idea पर एक साफ़ line, वैसे ही जैसे exam में जाते वक़्त आपके दिमाग़ में चाहिए।

State बनाम path. pressure, volume, temperature, और internal energy state हैं; heat और work path. internal-energy change हमेशा C-V पर चलता है। पूरे cycle में internal-energy change zero, तो net heat बराबर net work.

P-V graph पढ़ना। vertical isochoric, horizontal isobaric, हल्का curve isothermal, और steeper curve, gamma factor से steeper, adiabatic. work curve के नीचे का area है; clockwise loop का घिरा area एक engine का output.

capacities एक साँस में। degrees of freedom गिनो, monoatomic तीन, diatomic पाँच, polyatomic छह; C-V है f over two R; C-P के लिए R जोड़ो; gamma है five thirds, seven fifths, या four thirds. internal-energy change कभी C-P use नहीं करता।
engines और fridges. work है Q one minus Q two; efficiency Q one का take-home fraction; coefficient denominator हमेशा work, और coefficient एक से ज़्यादा हो सकता है।
second law शब्दों में। Kelvin-Planck efficiency one वाले engine को मना करता है; Clausius मुफ़्त heat cold से hot को; दोनों equivalent। reversible यानी slow और lossless साथ में, सिर्फ़ slow कभी नहीं।
Carnot ताज है। यह ceiling है, efficiency one minus T two over T one, हमेशा kelvin में, working substance से स्वतंत्र; और cold sink को नीचे लाना hot source को ऊपर करने से efficiency ज़्यादा बढ़ाता है।

entropy arrow को quantify करती है। यह reversible heat over temperature है; universe की entropy कभी नहीं घटती; irreversible problems के लिए system और surroundings बाँटो, हर एक निकालो, और जोड़ो; total सिर्फ़ reversible process के लिए zero.
एक exam reflex सबसे ऊपर। पहले process को नाम दो, फिर law चुनो; हर temperature kelvin में बदलो; और एक भी number रखने से पहले पूरा sign convention लिख लो।
